company.source_note:
Cognition Labs builds Devin, the world's leading autonomous AI software engineer that performs complex coding tasks end-to-end. The company acquired Windsurf (an AI coding IDE) last year and has integrated it into its platform. Devin has reached $492M ARR with rapid enterprise adoption, suggesting they need strong general counsel infrastructure to manage contracts (Mercedes, NASA, Goldman, Santander), IP ownership for autonomous code outputs, AI governance, and prepare for M&A at current valuation trajectory.
Size signal: Raised $1 billion at $25B pre-money valuation ($26B post-money); $492M annualized revenue run-rate; 50% MoM enterprise usage growth for 6 consecutive months; previously raised $400M at $10.2B post-money (September 2025) — tripled valuation in 8 months
Maturity signal: Founded by Scott Wu (CEO); maker of Devin (autonomous AI software engineer); acquired remaining bits of Windsurf (AI coding platform); enterprise customers include Mercedes-Benz, NASA, Goldman Sachs, Santander; round led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC with Founders Fund, Elad Gil, Ribbit Capital, Atreides, Layer Global as investors
Gate status: PASSED_BY_BROWSER — Firecrawl credits exhausted (same as previous night). Used browser tool directly to access TechCrunch, company websites, and GitHub for prospect sourcing. Source quality: HIGH — direct article reading, company websites, and LinkedIn-style sources. No enrichment via Apollo/Crunchbase possible due to credit exhaustion.
